hover_event.value: Based on Fabulously Optimized 14.1.0. Configured for technical redstone building.

contents.text: "H+C" means: hold H, then press C. The first key names the mod: H MiniHUD, M Litematica, X Tweakeroo, N TweakerMore, I Item Scroller, J Technical Utilities. Other keys can be searched in Options → Controls.

extra.text: Add or remove a multimeter meter on the targeted block
Show or hide the multimeter timeline
Step the multimeter timeline back / forward
Chunk Debug map (loaded and ticking chunks)
Empty hand click on a piston
Info view on / off: comparator level and hopper cooldown of the block you look at
Hold: show redstone dust update order
Block event throttler on / off (huge piston builds)
Hold while placing: rotate / offset the block
Placement restriction: plane, face, column, line, diagonal, layer
Swap the hotbar with inventory row 1, 2 or 3
Info overlay of the targeted schematic block
Save the area selection as a schematic
MiniHUD settings: slime chunks, spawn chunks, random ticks and more
Shaders on / off (if item icons vanish, change GUI Scale and back)
Minimap settings / new waypoint / waypoint list
Sort the inventory under the cursor
Find containers holding the hovered item
JEI: recipe / uses of the hovered item
All technical mod settings in one list
